content: Like the word subspace, the TF weighted word subspace is mathematically defined as a low-dimensional linear subspace in a word vector space with high dimensionality. However, a weighted version of the PCA BIBREF25 , BIBREF26 is utilized to incorporate the information given by the frequencies of words (term-frequencies). This TF weighted word subspace is equivalent to the word subspace if we consider all occurrences of the words.
